title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space

content.summary: In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative. With several others also pursuing the idea of putting AI data centers in space, including Google and Blue Origin, this is the first approval the agency has granted for a full "constellation" of AI satellites. The FCC's approval requires SpaceX to deploy at least one satellite by 2033, and meet the 1 million satellite milestone by 2040.
